data.description:
## Context

Three external code-review tools (CodeRabbit, Gitar, Copilot) were enabled on this repo's PRs. They post review comments without coordination with our pipeline. `respond-to-pr-comments` does not currently filter by author, so it would classify bot comments alongside human comments. There is also a pre-existing gap where our own llm reviewer's accepted-defense threads stay open on GitHub instead of being resolved.

## Scope

Author classification in `respond-to-pr-comments` for 4 classes: `human`, `dso-llm`, `coderabbitai[bot]`, `gitar-bot[bot]`, `copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]`. Bot findings route to telemetry-only (never enter cycle counter or resolve/defend gate; never trigger an additional review cycle). Per-push bot-comment scan adapter with `(reviewer_id, github_comment_id)` dedup so the same comment is not ingested twice across pushes.

Auto-resolve GitHub conversation threads uniformly across all 4 reviewer classes when the arbiter (Epic 1) rules DROP / DEFER-with-ticket, or when our reviewer's defense is accepted. This single mechanism simultaneously fixes today's gap for our own reviewer's defended threads.

## Approach (to be brainstormed)

- Extend `respond-to-pr-comments` to classify by author login
- Add a per-push bot-comment scan adapter (reads via `gh api`, dedups by comment ID)
- Wire DROP/DEFER/accepted-defense outcomes to `gh api -X PATCH .../pulls/comments/{id}` for thread resolution
- Bot-finding telemetry events (via Epic 2's adapter framework once available)

## Dependencies

- Epic 1 (cycle-end arbiter — arbiter rulings trigger auto-resolve)
- Epic 2 (telemetry endpoint — bot findings emit there)

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>`.
data.title: External reviewer integration (CodeRabbit/Gitar/Copilot) + auto-resolve PR threads
